QEMU Wasm third-party software

licenses. Copyright QEMU contributors; see full source headers and COPYING.
Local modifications: 2026-11-11, shared-memory import size, unsigned pointers,
thread lifecycle and browser fetch adapter. No warranty is provided.

SeaBIOS/SeaVGABIOS, iPXE, QEMU option ROMs, EDK2 packaging utility, GLib,
libffi, zlib, pixman, PCRE2, gvdb, Emscripten runtime, browser_wasi_shim,
xterm-pty and container2wasm retain their respective copyright/license terms.

Full preserved license texts, source archives, exact SHA256 manifests, local
patches and build instructions are available at ../../licenses/qemu/index.html
and ../../licenses/qemu/README.md on this same distribution.

The original prebuilt QEMU/proxy source-build correspondence is unverified.
See README for the explicit provenance limits; reproducible build or complete
corresponding source compliance is not claimed.
